text:
Asha (Marketing): Quick debrief — huge thanks everyone for getting the 'Practical Inference' webinar live. Need to capture post-launch actions and owners: recording/transcript, short clips for socials, survey analysis, lead tagging/routing, two follow-up email variants for A/B, and a concise benchmark narrative. I'll throw owners below.

Jon (Growth): Got the raw attendee export from Hopin, uploading to GDrive now: https://drive.google.com/xyz — I'll add tag columns 'webinar:practical-inference' and 'interest:dedicated/private'.

Priya (Product): I'll own the benchmark narrative — want to tighten claims around latency/cost. Need the transcript + the sample prompts used in the demo. @Asha can you drop those?

Asha (Marketing): Adding demo prompts & slide timestamps to the doc in a sec. Also we promised a short code snippet showing the batching config used in the demo — @Sam can you pull it from the demo repo?

Sam (Design): Yep, pulling now. Will paste snippet and then make a 30s clip that highlights "batching reduces per-token cost by ~x".

Sam (Design): ```bash
# example batching config from demo
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 32
  max_latency_ms: 15
```

Ben (Ops): SDR routing note — Megan and I hashed out routing rules: MQL threshold = attended >= 30min OR asked a question OR clicked "book demo" in follow-up. Megan wants a weekly digest. @Megan?

Megan (SDR): I can take these leads. Please tag as 'hand-off:Megan' and route to sales-ops queue. Also include 'interest-level' (high/medium/low) and source: 'webinar'.

Jon (Growth): I'll set a Zapier rule: attendee_time >= 1800 OR asked_question = true -> add tag + webhook to /sales/leads. Pinging @webhook-bot to confirm endpoint.

webhook-bot: Webhook to /sales/leads configured. Test payload successful.

Priya (Product): For follow-up messaging, propose A/B test:
A) Technical/economic: tight benchmarks + graph + CTA to run a short cost-latency eval with us.
B) Case-driven: short customer narrative + CTA to schedule a quick architecture review.
We need subject lines + 3 CTAs for each.

Asha (Marketing): I'll draft both email variants by EOD Friday and the 5-question post-webinar survey (keep it short): 1) top value you got, 2) biggest pain, 3) interest in Dedicated/Private, 4) willingness to buy/POC, 5) referrals. Will add to the shared sheet.

Sam (Design): I'll export 3 clips tomorrow: hero (30s), demo highlight (45s), speaker highlight (20s). Also make a LinkedIn square + 16:9 for the hero.

Jon (Growth): Metrics to track: recording views (day 1/7/30), follow-up CTR, demo bookings by cohort, leads routed -> MQL conversion. I'll stitch a small dashboard in Looker/GA this week.

Priya (Product): One ask for the benchmark doc: explicitly call out test bed (seq len, batch shape, GPU type), and uncertainty intervals. I'll template a small table so we don't overclaim.

Asha (Marketing): Owners summary: Recording/transcript = Jon + Sam; Clips/assets = Sam; Benchmark narrative = Priya; Leads routing & ops = Jon + Ben + Megan; Emails + survey = Asha; Dashboard = Jon. Next check-in Monday 10am. :thumbsup:

Megan (SDR): :thumbsup: I'll prep the handoff doc with sample email language for SDRs and the lead scoring rubric.

Ben (Ops): Small ops flag — include a calendar link for a 15m architecture review in the follow-up CTA (helps reduce long demo requests).

Asha (Marketing): Also thinking: slice benchmark narrative into a 4-slide LinkedIn carousel + 2 tweetable stats. @Sam can you create assets once Priya finalizes numbers?

Sam (Design): On it — will sync with Priya on the exact numbers before art.

Asha (Marketing): Thanks all. I'll add owners + deadlines to the doc and tag people. Closing thread unless anything urgent.

Jon (Growth): Thanks — will ping if data gaps.

Priya (Product): Thanks, locking in the narrative template now.

webhook-bot: Scheduled digest to /sales/ops at 8am Mon configured.
